topic: Enumerate all 23 HTML pages and Thai category filters for camp, national and representative-selection exams. Determine whether Download buttons expose links in static HTML or JS; map Buddhist Era years to Gregorian years; distinguish tasks from answer keys.

Audit year parameter and national timeline across older editions; some historical years show only F (11-12), unlike newer multiple age categories and rounds. Verify whether missing categories or rounds exist, and check solutions separately.
